traits.name: Golem Antimagic
traits.text: harmed by fire (4d6 (4d6), 1d10 (1d10) from areas or persistent damage); healed by cold (area 1d6 (1d6) HP); slowed by water.

traits.name: Icy Demise
traits.text: (arcane, cold, evocation); When an ice golem is destroyed, its body explodes in a blast of frigid air and razor-sharp ice, dealing 2d6 (2d6) slashing damage and 2d6 (2d6) cold damage to creatures in a 20-foot emanation, with a DC 19 basic Reflex save.

traits.name: Vulnerable to Endure Elements
traits.text: An ice golem can be targeted with endure elements even if it's not willing. If it is targeted, for 1 round it can't use Breath Weapon or benefit from creeping cold, and its fist attack doesn't deal cold damage.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, cold, evocation); The ice golem exhales a blast of freezing mist that deals 6d6 (6d6) cold damage in a 30-foot cone (DC 22 basic Reflex save). It can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Creeping Cold
traits.text: (arcane, cold, evocation); When the ice golem gets a critical hit with a fist Strike, the target also takes 2d6 (2d6) persistent cold damage and is slowed 1 for 1 round.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +15 (magical, versatile p); Damage 2d6+7 (2d6+7) bludgeoning plus 1d6 (1d6) cold
